what.title: What
what.text: A living library of practices drawn from ancient traditions — breathwork, meditation, yoga, kundalini, chakra work, and energy cultivation.

why.title: Why
why.text: Modern life disconnects us from our inner world. These practices rebuild that bridge — to presence, to vitality, to the deepest layers of awareness.

how.title: How
how.text: Each technique is presented with clear steps, benefits, contraindications, and the wisdom tradition it comes from. Practice safely and authentically.

techniques.title: Technique Library
techniques.subtitle: Explore {count} practices across breathwork, meditation, yoga, and more.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: ConsciousEnergy exists to make ancient transformative practices accessible to everyone. We believe that breathwork, meditation, yoga, and energy work are not esoteric curiosities — they are humanity's most time-tested technologies for well-being, self-understanding, and expanded consciousness.

disclaimer.title: Important Disclaimer
disclaimer.text: The practices on this website are for educational purposes only. They are not a substitute for medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional before beginning any new practice, especially if you have a medical condition. Some practices listed here may be intense — please read contraindications carefully.
